grain_conflict.examine_records: Compare the dispatch declaration of prime seed-corn with the threshold tally's damp-grain notation and the date of each entry.
grain_conflict.reconcile_accounts: Reconcile the tablet's barley quantity against the storehouse's live stock and its separate quality record.
grain_conflict.consult_official: Ask the grain clerk who certified the seed-corn declaration, what reserve they protected, and who bears the loss if the tally is right.
grain_conflict.inspect_source: Inspect the barley itself for damp, mold, and spoilage; compare its condition with the declared seed-corn quality.

grain_levy.examine_records: Read the levy roll's named households, assessed quantity, and issuing office before accepting the demand.
grain_levy.reconcile_accounts: Compare the levy quantity due with the institution's recorded grain and the amount already collected.
grain_levy.consult_official: Ask the levy clerk which households were assessed, what exemptions were recognized, and where the shortfall arose.
grain_levy.inspect_source: Inspect the named stores and collection point to compare the recorded grain with what is physically present.

travel_pass.examine_records: Check the traveler's identity, destination, issuing seal, and stated purpose against the pass register.
travel_pass.reconcile_accounts: Compare the requested passage fee and provisions with the institution's current travel allocation.
travel_pass.consult_official: Ask the issuing officer who authorized the journey and what restriction or obligation accompanies the pass.
travel_pass.inspect_source: Inspect the traveler's goods and departure point for items or conditions that conflict with the pass.

succession_claim.examine_records: Compare the succession claim's named heirs, dates, seals, and prior entries in the household register.
succession_claim.reconcile_accounts: Reconcile the claimed estate against existing land, stock, and obligation entries.
succession_claim.consult_official: Ask the responsible clerk which claim was entered first and what witness or seal supports the disputed succession.
succession_claim.inspect_source: Inspect the named property and its boundary or store marks for evidence relevant to the claimed inheritance.

pension_roll.examine_records: Read the pension roll's names, service entries, and recorded entitlement before authorizing a payment.
pension_roll.reconcile_accounts: Compare the pension total due with the institution's available silver and prior payments.
pension_roll.consult_official: Ask the responsible official who verified the claimants and why the roll requires this payment now.
pension_roll.inspect_source: Inspect the named household or office record for evidence that the claimant remains eligible.

bailiff_requisition.examine_records: Read the requisition's issuing office, destination, requested labor, and period outstanding; distinguish the order from proof of need.
bailiff_requisition.reconcile_accounts: Compare the requested labor and provisions with the destination institution's current stores and available manpower.
bailiff_requisition.consult_official: Ask the bailiff what work is blocked, which crew is short, and what obligation the province promises in return.
bailiff_requisition.inspect_source: Inspect the named work site and stores to establish whether the reported obstruction and shortage are present.

held_barley.examine_records: Read the hold order and identify who placed the barley under seal, when, and on what stated grounds.
held_barley.reconcile_accounts: Compare the held quantity with the institution's usable barley and the amount excluded from distribution.
held_barley.consult_official: Ask the grain clerk who ordered the hold and what evidence would permit the barley to be released.
held_barley.inspect_source: Inspect the held barley and its storage place for the condition cited in the hold order.

consignment_receipt.examine_records: Read the consignment receipt's origin, destination, commodity, quantity, and receiving mark.
consignment_receipt.reconcile_accounts: Compare the received quantity with the dispatch total and the institution's current stock entry.
consignment_receipt.consult_official: Ask the receiving official who counted the consignment and whether any shortage or damage was recorded at arrival.
consignment_receipt.inspect_source: Inspect the consignment and receiving place for damage, missing goods, or marks of an unrecorded transfer.

hazard.examine_records: Read the hazard entry's location, reported cause, loss rate, and period first recorded.
hazard.reconcile_accounts: Compare the accumulated loss with the current stock and the institution's repair resources.
hazard.consult_official: Ask the responsible official when the damage began, what has been attempted, and what repair they request.
hazard.inspect_source: Inspect the named site and affected stores to verify the reported damage and whether it remains active.

pressure.examine_records: Read the institution's pressure entry and identify which recorded obligation or shortage raised it.
pressure.reconcile_accounts: Compare the institution's stock, membership, and activity records to identify the current source of pressure.
pressure.consult_official: Ask the office holder which obligation cannot be met and which resource or appointment would relieve it.
pressure.inspect_source: Inspect the institution's stores and working place to compare the reported pressure with present conditions.

project_review.examine_records: Read the current project stage, certified progress, outstanding obligation, and last review decision.
project_review.reconcile_accounts: Compare labor, materials, and provisions committed with the project's recorded progress.
project_review.consult_official: Ask the project officer what is preventing the next stage and which obligation they need the office to settle.
project_review.inspect_source: Inspect the active work site and compare completed work with the last certified stage.

ledger.examine_records: Read the institution's current membership, activity, and stock entries; note which records have no supporting source.
ledger.reconcile_accounts: Reconcile each recorded stockpile with its live institutional balance and outstanding obligations.
ledger.consult_official: Ask the office holder which entries they can personally attest to and which remain unverified.
ledger.inspect_source: Inspect the institution's stores and work area to compare physical conditions with the ledger.
